cases.title: X 上最值得关注的 21 个 Grok Bot 探索者
cases.titleEn: 21 Grok Bot explorers worth following on X
cases.summary: Mai Yang 在深圳 Meetup 当天整理的名单：先看官方三人（Matt Palmer 入门片、Lauren 省额度、Eric 多团队），再看产品组和把 Bot 当同事用的人。部分条目作者自己标了未核到原文。
cases.summaryEn: Mai Yang’s list from Grok Bot Meetup Shenzhen: start with three official accounts (Matt Palmer’s intro, Lauren on spend, Eric on multi-team), then the product crew and people who run bots as teammates. Some later entries the author marked unverified.
cases.qualityNote: 社区盘点，不是官方目录。1–3 和 Guides 库、Matt 入门片已在本库。13 是 Elon 转过的 XFreeze。14 的曝光数字是原文，作者说没复现。19–21 作者标了待补。
cases.qualityNoteEn: A community roundup, not the official catalog. Items 1–3 and the Guides library / Matt intro are already in this library. 13 is the XFreeze post Elon quoted. 14’s reach numbers are the author’s; Mai Yang says he did not reproduce them. 19–21 are marked incomplete.

cases.title: 官方 Grok Bot Guides：把 Agent 当同事的实操手册
cases.titleEn: Official Grok Bot Guides: playbooks for AI teammates
cases.summary: xAI 官方 playbook 库，不是角色目录。五篇可跟做：多团队频道排班、手游工作室、用 Bot 做设计、企业 GTM、产品经理带一桌 Bot。Elon 转发「How to use Grok Bot」。
cases.summaryEn: xAI’s official playbook library — not the role catalog. Five follow-along guides: multi-team channels, a mobile game studio, designing with bots, enterprise GTM, and PMs running a bot roster. Elon quote-tweeted “How to use Grok Bot.”
cases.qualityNote: Elon 转发。官方五篇实操手册，和 x.ai/bot/use-cases 角色目录不是同一页。手游篇和库里已有的 Rank'em 案例同源，手册页是官方入口。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Quote-tweeted by Elon. Five official playbooks; not the same page as the x.ai/bot/use-cases role catalog. The mobile guide is the official door to the Rank'em case already in the library.
cases.approvalBoundary: 组桌和交接可以跟做；对外发帖、付款、改日历仍要人审。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Follow the roster and handoff pattern; still review before posting, paying, or changing calendars.

cases.title: 非官方 Linux 版 Grok Bot：从 Windows 安装包移植
cases.titleEn: Unofficial Linux Grok Bot (Windows installer port)
cases.summary: 社区把官方 Windows Electron 安装包搬到 Linux：make build 产出 .deb / AppImage / 解压目录，用同一 Cursor / SuperGrok 账号登录。云端电脑不变，本机构建只是遥控器。README 写清依赖、无沙箱参数与 NVIDIA 黑屏 workaround。非 xAI/Cursor 产品。
cases.summaryEn: Community port of the official Windows Electron installer to Linux: `make build` yields .deb, AppImage, or a tarball; sign in with the same Cursor / SuperGrok account. Bots still live on the cloud computer — this build is the remote control. README covers deps, --no-sandbox, and an NVIDIA black-window workaround. Not an xAI/Cursor product.
cases.qualityNote: Show HN / HN item 49467702。可跟做的 Linux 构建步骤；官方仍不支持 Linux，自行承担风险，不要用它绕过账号条款。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Show HN / HN item 49467702. Follow-along Linux build steps; Linux remains unsupported officially — use at your own risk and do not treat it as a ToS bypass.

cases.title: 六席 Bot 跑手游工作室：Rank'em
cases.summary: Ryan Perry 用六个 Grok Bot 分工跑手游 Rank'em 生命周期：Mobile Orchestrator、Rankem Engineer、Creatives、GCS、Analytics、Bug fix。每个 Bot 有独立电脑、例行任务与技能，互相交接而不经过人。编码工具覆盖构建与基建，Grok Bot 接住发行、QA、买量和素材。文章写清角色、交接与真实踩坑。
cases.summaryEn: Ryan Perry staffed Rank'em with six Grok Bots — Mobile Orchestrator, Rankem Engineer, Creatives, GCS, Analytics, Bug fix — each with its own computer, routines, and skills, handing off without routing through him. Coding tools cover build/infra; Grok Bot covers release, QA, UA, and creative. The post spells out roles, handoffs, and what they caught.
cases.qualityNote: 社区完整案例研究（HN item 49447324）：六个窄角色 + 真实手游下载过千。可复现的多 Bot 工作室搭法，付款/投放变更仍需人审。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Full community case study (HN item 49447324): six narrow seats on a live game past 1k downloads. A reproducible multi-bot studio pattern; still review spend and store changes.
cases.approvalBoundary: 不直接改广告预算、不提交商店上架、不推生产；只起草与交接，花钱与发布留给人。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change ad spend, submit store listings, or ship production; draft and hand off — humans own money and release.

cases.title: Grok Bot 入门：从解剖到四条工作流
cases.summary: SpaceXAI 的 Matt Palmer 做的 30 分钟入门片：Bot 是什么、解剖结构、三种运行方式、多 Bot 串联，以及四条可跟做的工作流——X 粉丝进 Notion、个人软件、用 Cursor 写代码、搜索。时间轴写在推文里。
cases.summaryEn: A 30-minute getting-started from SpaceXAI’s Matt Palmer: what a Bot is, its anatomy, three ways to run, multi-bot chains, and four follow-along workflows — X followers into Notion, personal software, coding with Cursor, and search. Chapters are in the post.
cases.qualityNote: 官方团队出的入门视频，四条工作流可直接跟做。适合当 Grok Bot 库的第一课，外发到 Notion 前仍要人审。
cases.qualityNoteEn: A getting-started video from the product team with four follow-along workflows. A good first lesson for the Grok Bot library; still review before writing to Notion.
cases.approvalBoundary: 写入 Notion 或对外发帖前需人审；不要在演示里暴露密钥。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Review before writing to Notion or posting; do not expose secrets in the demo.

cases.title: 每日简报写手：只收真正重要的故事
cases.summary: 官方 Daily Briefing Writer：用高质量输入开场，而不是噪音；只交付对你真正重要的故事，一份收紧的每日简报。不发送、不改日程。
cases.qualityNote: 官方目录角色，今早 65 条入库时被当成 chief-of-staff-digest 近重复漏掉。幕僚长对照优先级扫 Slack/邮件/日历；这里是新闻/故事简报。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不对外发送简报、不改日历；只返回待审的故事短名单。
cases.summaryEn: Official Daily Briefing Writer: start the day with high-quality inputs instead of noise. Delivers a tight daily brief of only the stories that matter to you. Does not send or change the calendar.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog role missed as a near-dupe of chief-of-staff-digest in the morning 65-case ingest. Chief of Staff maps Slack/email/calendar to priorities; this is a news/story brief.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send the brief or change the calendar; return a review-only shortlist of stories.

cases.title: 行政助理：晨间简报与入室补上下文
cases.summary: 官方 Executive Assistant：不必泡在频道里也能保持定向。交付晨间简报，并在你加入新房间时自动补一份上下文摘要，避免刚进线程就迷路。不代发消息、不改会议。
cases.qualityNote: 官方目录角色，今早 65 条入库时被当成幕僚长/会议替身近重复漏掉。幕僚长是优先级对照摘要；会议替身是缺席入会；这里是晨报 + 入室补上下文。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送消息、不改会议、不代为承诺；只返回晨间简报与入室补上下文。
cases.summaryEn: Official Executive Assistant: stay oriented without living in channels. Delivers a morning briefing, plus an automatic catch-up summary whenever you join a new room, so you are never lost in a thread you just entered. Does not send messages or change meetings.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog role missed as a near-dupe of chief-of-staff-digest / meeting-stand-in in the morning 65-case ingest. Chief of Staff is a priority map; Meeting Stand-in joins when you are absent; this is a morning brief plus in-room catch-up.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send messages, change meetings, or make commitments; return the morning briefing and in-room catch-up only.

cases.title: Newsletter 写手：按时出月度更新
cases.summary: 官方 Newsletter Writer：按时发出月度营销与产品更新。从发布、赢单和日历拉取新内容，按你的声音写好当期，停在待审，让营销改一次就能发。
cases.qualityNote: 官方目录角色，今早 65 条入库时被当成 one-person-company-stack 近重复漏掉。一人公司栈是多 Agent 运营模型里顺带写 newsletter；这里是独立的月度 Newsletter 写手。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不对外发送 Newsletter、不改已发布档期；只返回待审当期草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Newsletter Writer: ship monthly marketing and product updates on time. Pulls what's new from launches, wins, and your calendar, writes the issue in your voice, and parks it for review so marketing can edit once and send.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog role missed as a near-dupe of one-person-company-stack in the morning 65-case ingest. The one-person stack is a multi-agent ops model that happens to include a newsletter; this is a standalone monthly Newsletter Writer.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send the newsletter or change published dates; return the parked issue draft only.

cases.title: 拓客计划搭建手：播种+补全+追踪表
cases.summary: 官方 Prospecting Plan Builder：搭好本周工作簿。播种联系人、补全邮箱/手机，并写出可直接上手的追踪表，让外呼从名单开始。不发送、不改 CRM。
cases.qualityNote: 官方目录角色，今早 65 条入库时被当成 sales-outbound-overnight / account-research-specialist 近重复漏掉。外呼是隔夜打分+草稿；研究专员是上手前研究包；这里是本周拓客名单与追踪表。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送外呼、不改 CRM、不入组；只返回播种名单、补全字段与待审追踪表。
cases.summaryEn: Official Prospecting Plan Builder: build the week's book of work. Seeds contacts, enriches email/mobile, and writes a ready-to-work tracker so outbound starts from a list. No send, no CRM writes.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog role missed as a near-dupe of sales-outbound-overnight / account-research-specialist in the morning 65-case ingest. Outbound is overnight scoring plus drafts; Account Research is a pre-touch pack; this is the week's prospecting list and tracker.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send outreach, edit the CRM, or add to sequences; return the seeded list, enrichments, and review-only tracker.

cases.title: 状态报告写手：活清单+晨间摘要
cases.summary: 官方 Status Report Writer：把待办握在手里，避免漏项。从文档、会议和 Slack 拉取未完成事项，合成一份活清单和晨间摘要。不发送、不关项。
cases.qualityNote: 官方目录角色，今早 65 条入库时被当成幕僚长/会议笔记近重复漏掉。幕僚长对照优先级扫频道；会议笔记落任务；这里是跨文档/会议/Slack 的活待办清单 + 晨间摘要。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送摘要、不改他人任务、不关闭事项；只返回活清单与待审晨间摘要。
cases.summaryEn: Official Status Report Writer: own the to-do so nothing slips. Pulls open action items from docs, meetings, and Slack into one living list and a morning digest. Does not send or close items.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog role missed as a near-dupe of chief-of-staff-digest / meeting-notes-tasks in the morning 65-case ingest. Chief of Staff maps channels to priorities; meeting notes drop tasks; this is a living action list plus morning digest.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send the digest, change others' tasks, or close items; return the living list and review-only morning digest.

cases.title: CRM 运营经理：会前会后清洁记录
cases.summary: 官方 CRM Operations Manager：保持管道干净。在会议前后处理 CRM 与组织架构卫生，让记录保持最新，不必再人工过一遍。写入默认停在审批。
cases.qualityNote: 官方目录角色，今早 65 条入库时被当成 crm-monday-scoreboard（Pipeline Analyst）近重复漏掉。周一记分板是停滞/承诺风险看板；这里是会前会后的 CRM 与组织架构卫生。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不擅自改 CRM 或组织架构、不对外发更新；会前会后卫生写入停在审批。
cases.summaryEn: Official CRM Operations Manager: keep the pipeline clean. Handles CRM and org-chart hygiene before and after meetings so records stay current without a manual pass. Writes stop for approval by default.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog role missed as a near-dupe of crm-monday-scoreboard (Pipeline Analyst) in the morning 65-case ingest. The Monday scoreboard is a stall/commit-risk board; this is pre- and post-meeting CRM and org-chart hygiene.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not write to the CRM or org chart, and do not send updates; park hygiene edits for approval.

cases.title: 公寓侦察：上架即筛、约看、再申请
cases.summary: 官方 Life & Leverage 角色 Apartment Scout：房源一上架就按条件筛出短名单，邮件预约看房时间，只对你点头的房源提交申请。对外发信、预约与申请默认停在审批。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 use-cases 目录新角色，生活向、可复现：筛房→约看→等人选再申请。与已有买菜/建站不同。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不擅自预约看房、不提交申请、不对外发邮件；只返回符合条件的短名单与待发预约草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Life & Leverage role Apartment Scout: as soon as listings hit the market it filters a shortlist, emails to book tour times, and applies only for the ones you pick. Outbound mail, bookings, and applications stop for approval by default.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official catalog role. Reproducible life-admin flow: filter → book tours → apply only after you pick. Distinct from grocery shopping and website builder.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not book tours, submit applications, or send email; return only an eligible shortlist and draft booking messages.

cases.title: 差旅协调：比价占位，等人批再出票
cases.summary: 官方 Travel Coordinator：按你的规则比较航班与酒店，先占住快过期的优选项，确认后才预订，并把行程写进日历。出票、付款与改签必须人审。
cases.qualityNote: 官方目录明确「先占位、确认后再订」。与会议替身、办公室排班不同：对象是机票酒店。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不付款、不出票、不改签；只返回比价结果、建议选项与待确认占位。
cases.summaryEn: Official Travel Coordinator: compares flights and hotels against your rules, holds the best option before it expires, books only after you confirm, and drops the itinerary onto the calendar. Ticketing, payment, and changes need a human.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog is explicit: hold first, book after confirm. Distinct from meeting stand-in and office-manager scheduling.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not pay, ticket, or change bookings; return only the comparison, a recommended hold, and a confirm request.

cases.title: 日历协调：跨日历约齐人并追 hold
cases.summary: 官方 Recruiting & People 角色 Calendar Coordinator：跨多本日历把人约到同一房间，并追那些没人有空去追的 hold。对外发邀请与改期默认停在审批。
cases.qualityNote: 官方目录新角色。已有会议笔记→任务、会议替身都不覆盖「跨日历追 convene / hold」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送会议邀请、不改他人日历；只返回可行时段、冲突说明与待发邀请草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Recruiting & People role Calendar Coordinator: gets people in the same room across calendars and chases the holds nobody else has time to chase. External invites and reschedules stop for approval by default.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official role. Existing meeting-notes and meeting-stand-in do not cover cross-calendar convening and hold-chasing.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send invites or change others’ calendars; return feasible slots, conflicts, and draft invites only.

cases.title: 招聘筛选：只把过线的人交给面试
cases.summary: 官方 Hiring Screener：按既定标准给申请或作品打分，交出 ATS 可直接审的评审包。和 Talent Scout 的「对外寻源」不同——这里吃的是已投递材料。不联系候选人。
cases.qualityNote: 官方把寻源（Talent Scout）和筛选分成两个角色。现有 29 条只有寻源。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不联系候选人、不改 ATS 状态、不拒绝或推进；只返回带证据的打分与待审名单。
cases.summaryEn: Official Hiring Screener: scores applications or work samples against a defined bar and hands off an ATS-ready review. Distinct from Talent Scout (outbound sourcing)—this role consumes inbound materials. Do not contact candidates.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog splits sourcing (Talent Scout) from screening. The existing 29 only cover sourcing.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not contact candidates, change ATS status, reject, or advance anyone; return a scored, evidence-backed review list only.

cases.title: 入职经理：给新人一条路径而不是一堆链接
cases.summary: 官方 Onboarding Manager：为新员工建清单、抽齐文档、回答 Day-1 问题，并把卡住的事项路由给能解堵的人。不擅自开通账号或对外发欢迎信。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 People 向新角色。现有 Talent Scout / 办公室经理都不覆盖新员工入职路径。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不开通账号、不改权限、不对外发欢迎信；只返回入职清单、文档包与待路由问题。
cases.summaryEn: Official Onboarding Manager: builds the checklist, pulls the right docs, answers day-one questions, and routes each ask to whoever can unblock it. Does not provision accounts or send welcome mail on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official People role. Talent Scout and Office Manager do not cover a new-hire path.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not provision accounts, change permissions, or send welcome mail; return the checklist, doc pack, and routed questions only.

cases.title: 客户研究专员：先分层再上手
cases.summary: 官方 Sales 角色 Account Research Specialist：在你碰客户之前，从 Salesforce 加实时信号分层，给拟合度与热度打分，并产出可分享的研究包。不写外呼、不改 CRM。
cases.qualityNote: 官方把「隔夜外呼」和「上手前研究包」拆开。现有 sales-outbound 覆盖外呼草稿，不覆盖独立研究包。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不联系客户、不改 CRM、不入组；只返回分层、打分与带出处的研究包。
cases.summaryEn: Official Sales role Account Research Specialist: before you touch accounts, pulls Salesforce plus live signals, scores fit and warmth, and builds a shareable research pack per account. No outreach, no CRM edits.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog splits overnight outbound from pre-touch research packs. Existing sales-outbound covers drafts, not a standalone research pack.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not contact accounts, edit the CRM, or add to sequences; return tiers, scores, and sourced research packs only.

cases.title: 会前准备搭档：带着房间里的人与未结事项进会
cases.summary: 官方 Meeting Prep Buddy：从日历、笔记、CRM、Gong、Slack 拼出会前包——谁在房间、上次接触、未结线程、建议议程。与会议笔记落任务、会议替身不同：这是会前，不是会中/会后。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Sales 新角色。现有会议类案例都是会中替身或会后任务，没有会前包。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改会议、不发会前信、不更新 CRM；只返回会前包。
cases.summaryEn: Official Meeting Prep Buddy: builds prep packs from calendar, notes, CRM, Gong, and Slack—who is in the room, last touch, open threads, and a suggested agenda. Distinct from meeting-notes tasks and meeting stand-in: this is before the call.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Sales role. Existing meeting cases are in-meeting stand-in or post-meeting tasks, not a prep pack.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change meetings, send pre-reads, or update the CRM; return the prep pack only.

cases.title: 销售通话教练：每通 Gong 都留下作业
cases.summary: 官方 Sales Call Coach：复盘 Gong 通话，按时间戳点评发现、异议与高管场控，并给通话打分，让每通都留下作业。不改 CRM、不给客户发跟进。
cases.qualityNote: 官方新角色，对象是通话教练而非外呼或客户跟进。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不把点评发给销售本人以外的人、不改 CRM、不联系客户；只返回带时间戳的教练笔记与分数。
cases.summaryEn: Official Sales Call Coach: reviews Gong calls and leaves timestamped coaching on discovery, objections, and executive presence, plus a call score—homework after every call. No CRM edits, no customer follow-up.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official role. Owns call coaching, not outbound or account follow-up.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not share coaching outside the seller, edit the CRM, or contact the customer; return timestamped notes and a score only.

cases.title: 交易台协调：先拟内部 deal note，批准后再写入 Salesforce
cases.summary: 官方 Deal Desk Coordinator：从历史邮件、Salesforce 和通话起草带上下文的内部交易说明，你批准后再提交进 Salesforce。改价、条款与对外承诺必须人审。
cases.qualityNote: 官方明确「先拟、批准后再写入 Salesforce」。现有管道记分板不覆盖交易台纸面。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不提交 Salesforce、不改价格或条款、不对外承诺；只返回内部 deal note 草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Deal Desk Coordinator: drafts contextual internal deal notes from past emails, Salesforce, and calls, then submits in Salesforce once you approve. Pricing, terms, and external commitments stay behind approval.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official copy is explicit: draft first, write to Salesforce after approval. The Monday scoreboard does not cover deal-desk paper.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not submit to Salesforce, change price or terms, or commit externally; return the internal deal-note draft only.

cases.title: 续约台：带着 90 天包走进每场续约
cases.summary: 官方 Renewal Desk Operator：按客户从用量、工单、Gong、CRM 拼 90 天续约包，起草商务说明，只有条款卡住才去催法务。不联系客户、不改合同。
cases.qualityNote: 官方把续约台从客户健康观察名单里拆出来：产出是 90 天商务包，不是风险榜。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不联系客户、不改合同或报价、不催法务以外的人；只返回续约包与待审商务说明。
cases.summaryEn: Official Renewal Desk Operator: builds a 90-day pack per account from usage, tickets, Gong, and CRM, drafts the commercial note, and nudges legal only when terms are stuck. No customer contact, no contract edits.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog splits renewal desk from account-health watch: the output is a 90-day commercial pack, not a risk list.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not contact the customer, change contracts or quotes, or ping anyone but legal when stuck; return the pack and draft commercial note only.

cases.title: 幻灯片现场更新：发现纪要从会中写进下一页
cases.summary: 官方 Deck Updater：根据发现纪要在会中或会后立刻改 Deck，并把下一步写进幻灯片，让你离开房间时页面已经在动。不对外发 Deck、不改主模板品牌。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Sales 新角色。现有内容案例是广告视频/建站，没有会中改 Deck。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不把 Deck 发给客户、不改主模板；只更新本次会议用的副本并标出改动。
cases.summaryEn: Official Deck Updater: updates your deck from discovery notes mid-call or right after, with next steps baked in, so you leave the room with the slide already moving. Does not send the deck or change the master brand system.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Sales role. Existing content cases are ad video / site build, not mid-call deck updates.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send the deck to the customer or change the master template; update this meeting’s copy and mark the diffs.

cases.title: Beta 采用观察：看谁真的在用新功能
cases.summary: 官方 Product 角色 Beta Adoption Watcher：盯用量，标出哪些客户已经进来试用新功能，方便团队跟进。不联系客户、不改功能开关。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Product 新角色。客户健康是流失/扩张，这里是「新功能谁在用」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不联系客户、不改功能开关或实验分组；只返回采用名单与证据链接。
cases.summaryEn: Official Product role Beta Adoption Watcher: monitors usage and surfaces which customers are actually in on the new feature so the team can follow up. No customer contact, no flag flips.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Product role. Account Health is churn/expansion; this is “who is actually using the new feature.”
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not contact customers or change flags/experiments; return the adoption list and evidence links only.

cases.title: 通话 FAQ 挖掘：用真实通话养活赋能文档
cases.summary: 官方 Call FAQ Miner：从真实通话里追踪问题、给回答打时间戳，并链回源录音，让赋能材料跟着通话更新。不改对外帮助中心、不把摘录当最终话术发布。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Product 新角色。现有会议笔记落任务不覆盖「从通话挖 FAQ + 时间戳回链」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发布到帮助中心或对外话术库；只返回带时间戳与源录音链接的 FAQ 草案。
cases.summaryEn: Official Call FAQ Miner: keeps enablement current from real calls—tracks questions, timestamps answers, and links back to the source recording. Does not publish to the help center or treat excerpts as final scripts.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Product role. Meeting-notes→tasks does not cover mining FAQs with timestamped source recordings.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not publish to the help center or external scripts; return a FAQ draft with timestamps and source links only.

cases.title: 文档审计：对照上周发版抓过期页
cases.summary: 官方 Docs Auditor：把帮助中心和内部说明对照上周已发版功能做 diff，标出过期页并起草改写。不直接改线上文档。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Product 新角色。现有产品性能调查不覆盖文档过期审计。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不直接改线上帮助中心或对外文档；只返回过期页清单与改写草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Docs Auditor: diffs the help center and internal notes against what shipped last week, flags stale pages, and drafts the rewrite. Does not edit live docs.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Product role. Product-performance investigation does not cover stale-docs audit.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not edit the live help center or public docs; return the stale-page list and rewrite drafts only.

cases.title: 需求溯源：永远不丢「谁提的这功能」
cases.summary: 官方 Feature Request Tracker：从 Slack 和通话里挖需求，做成绑到具体客户的活清单，让规格书有真实需求轨迹。不建票、不承诺排期。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Product 新角色。现有客服退款/工单分拣不覆盖「需求溯源到客户」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不新建工单、不承诺排期、不回复客户；只返回绑到客户的需求清单与出处。
cases.summaryEn: Official Feature Request Tracker: mines Slack and calls into a living list tied to customers, so the spec has a real demand trail. Does not file tickets or promise a schedule.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Product role. Support refunds / ticket triage do not cover a customer-tied demand trail.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not file tickets, promise a schedule, or reply to customers; return a customer-tied request list with sources only.

cases.title: 产品反馈分析：把散落信号收成优先视图
cases.summary: 官方 Product Feedback Analyst：从已连接来源收集并聚类反馈，权衡证据与紧急度，起草路由建议等人批准。不改路线图、不回用户。
cases.qualityNote: 官方把反馈聚类/路由从需求溯源、性能调查里拆出来。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改路线图、不回复用户、不建工单；只返回聚类、证据与待批路由建议。
cases.summaryEn: Official Product Feedback Analyst: collects and clusters feedback from connected sources, weighs evidence and urgency, and drafts routing recommendations for approval. No roadmap edits, no user replies.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog splits clustered feedback routing from request tracking and performance investigation.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change the roadmap, reply to users, or file tickets; return clusters, evidence, and routing drafts only.

cases.title: 玩法测试操作员：API 不够时硬开 UI
cases.summary: 官方 Playtest Operator：当 API 不够用时，在电脑上硬走产品路径、捕获失败，并交回一份紧凑发现包。与 Bug 复现不同——这是主动压路径，不是跟一张报修走。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Engineering 新角色。现有 bug-repro / Slack 复现是跟报修走；这里是主动玩法压测。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改生产、不碰真实客户数据、不提 PR；只返回步骤、截图与发现包。
cases.summaryEn: Official Playtest Operator: brute-force tests the product path on a computer when APIs are not enough, captures failures, and returns a tight findings pack. Distinct from bug reproduction: this is proactive path-pressing, not following one ticket.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Engineering role. Existing bug-repro follows a report; this proactively playtests a path.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change production, touch real customer data, or open a PR; return steps, screenshots, and a findings pack only.

cases.title: 原型构建：从一句话到可点的 URL
cases.summary: 官方 Prototype Builder：在自己的电脑上写，尽快从需求变成可点的东西，回来时带截图和线上 URL。不买域名、不接生产流量。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Engineering 新角色。现有建站 Bot 是买域名部署上线；这里停在可点原型。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不买域名、不绑生产、不公开推广；只返回原型 URL、截图与已知限制。
cases.summaryEn: Official Prototype Builder: writes on its computer and goes from ask to something clickable fast, coming back with a screenshot plus a live URL. Does not buy a domain or attach production traffic.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Engineering role. Website Builder buys a domain and ships live; this stops at a clickable prototype.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not buy a domain, attach production, or promote publicly; return the prototype URL, screenshots, and known limits.

cases.title: 云端 Agent 编排：盯一堆 run，卡住再催
cases.summary: 官方 Cloud Agent Orchestrator：同时拉起多个 cloud agent run，监控进度、追卡住的任务，并汇总报告，避免你逐个盯。不改生产、不扩大权限。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Engineering 新角色。现有 Cursor Automations 是相邻产品；这里是 Grok Bot 自己编排 cloud agent run。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改生产配置、不扩大权限、不合并无人审的结果；只拉起 run、追卡住的、交汇总。
cases.summaryEn: Official Cloud Agent Orchestrator: kicks off many cloud-agent runs, monitors them, chases what is stuck, and summarizes the report so you are not babysitting each one. No production changes, no permission expansion.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Engineering role. Cursor Automations is adjacent; this is Grok Bot owning a fleet of cloud-agent runs.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change production, expand permissions, or merge unreviewed results; start runs, chase stuck ones, and return the summary.

cases.title: 安全问卷填写：门户里先填满，提交留给你
cases.summary: 官方 Security Questionnaire Filler：登录供应商安全问卷站，从你们的 trust center 和历史 RFP 抽答案，填好每个字段，提交按钮留给你。不臆造合规结论。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Ops 新角色，计算机使用典型场景：没干净 API 的门户代填。现有 29 条没有安全问卷。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不点击提交、不签署、不发明没有出处的答案；缺证据就标「待补」。
cases.summaryEn: Official Security Questionnaire Filler: logs into the vendor questionnaire site, pulls answers from your trust center and past RFPs, drafts every field, and parks submit for you. Does not invent compliance answers.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Ops role and a canonical computer-use job: portals with no clean API. None of the existing 29 cover security questionnaires.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not submit or sign, and do not invent unsourced answers; mark gaps as needs-input.

cases.title: 供应商门户代劳：每周走同一条无 API 路径
cases.summary: 官方 Vendor Portal Operator：在没有干净 API 的门户上跑续约、席位和采购，每周点同一条路径，只把例外带回来。下单、改席位、付款必须人审。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Ops 新角色。办公室经理是工单/排班门户；这里是供应商续约与采购门户。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不下单、不改席位、不付款；只返回本周例外与待批操作清单。
cases.summaryEn: Official Vendor Portal Operator: runs renewals, seats, and procurement on portals with no clean API, clicks the same path every week, and comes back with exceptions only. Orders, seat changes, and payments need a human.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Ops role. Office Manager is work-order portals; this is vendor renewal and procurement portals.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not place orders, change seats, or pay; return this week’s exceptions and a pending-action list.

cases.title: 合同台：一周纸面按阶段和负责人一览
cases.summary: 官方 Contract Desk：按阶段和负责人汇总本周合同，抽出关键条款，标出卡住的评审。不改条款、不代表签字。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Finance 新角色。现有发票管道/费用管家不覆盖合同阶段与条款抽取。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改条款、不签字、不对外发合同；只返回阶段表、关键条款与阻塞清单。
cases.summaryEn: Official Contract Desk: summarizes the week of paper by stage and owner, pulls key terms, and flags blocked reviews. No term edits, no signing.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Finance role. Invoice pipeline and expense manager do not cover contract stages or term extraction.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not edit terms, sign, or send contracts; return the stage table, key terms, and blockers only.

cases.title: 退款追回经理：找到索赔、提交并跟到底
cases.summary: 官方扩容帖「Refunds manager」：找到索赔、提交并跟进，带着追回的退款或折扣回来。这是你作为消费者/采购方去追钱，不是客服给用户办政策内退款。
cases.qualityNote: 官方「Jobs Bots are doing today」新角色。已有 support-in-policy-refunds 是客服给用户退款；这里方向相反：替你追索赔。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不提交索赔、不接受和解、不改支付方式；只返回可追索清单、草稿材料与跟进状态。
cases.summaryEn: Official expansion-post Refunds manager: finds the claim, files it, and follows it through, coming back with the refund or discount it recovered. This is you claiming money back—not in-policy customer refunds.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official “Jobs Bots are doing today” role. Existing support-in-policy-refunds issues refunds to customers; this files claims on your behalf.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not file a claim, accept a settlement, or change payment methods; return the recoverable list, draft packets, and follow-up status.

cases.title: SEO / AEO 审计：关键词、技术和 AI 提示一起盯
cases.summary: 官方 SEO / AEO Auditor：把关键词、技术、AI 提示和对手动向收在一处，告诉你在涨还是在丢，标出该修的站点问题，并给出可执行优化计划。不直接改线上页面。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有竞争情报蜂群是模拟公司，不是站点 SEO/AEO 审计。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改线上页面、不发内容、不买外链；只返回审计与优化计划。
cases.summaryEn: Official SEO / AEO Auditor: tracks keyword, technical, AI-prompt, and competitor movement in one place, surfaces whether you are gaining or losing ground, flags site issues, and returns an optimization plan. Does not edit live pages.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. Competitive-intel swarm is a company simulation, not a site SEO/AEO audit.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not edit live pages, publish, or buy links; return the audit and the plan only.

cases.title: 社媒经理：按你的声音起草，排队等人点发布
cases.summary: 官方 Social Media Manager：研究你的真实历史发文，有值得说的上线就起草，把帖子停在待发布队列并保持队列流动。不自行发布、不互动。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有一人公司/newsletter 栈不是独立的社媒排队 Bot。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发布、不点赞、不回复；只返回草稿与建议发布时间。
cases.summaryEn: Official Social Media Manager: studies your real history, drafts when something noteworthy ships, parks posts for you to publish, and keeps the queue moving. Does not publish or engage on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. The one-person newsletter stack is not a dedicated social queue Bot.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not publish, like, or reply; return drafts and a suggested post window only.

cases.title: 付费素材策略：在赢家变明显之前写下假设
cases.summary: 官方 Paid Media Creative Strategist：尽早抓住创意赢家，写清「为什么有效」的假设，并提出下一轮测试。官方强调不编造指标。与付费预算监控不同。
cases.qualityNote: 官方把素材策略从付费预算监控里拆出来。现有 paid-media-monitor 只做花费/CAC 再分配。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改广告、不改预算、不发明指标；只返回假设、证据与下一测建议。
cases.summaryEn: Official Paid Media Creative Strategist: spots early creative winners, writes a sharp why-it-works hypothesis, and proposes the next test. Official rule: no invented metrics. Distinct from paid-media budget monitoring.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official catalog splits creative strategy from budget monitoring. Existing paid-media-monitor only reallocates spend/CAC.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change ads or budgets, and do not invent metrics; return the hypothesis, evidence, and next-test plan.

cases.title: LinkedIn 投放经理：广告、表单、跟进和 UTM 对齐
cases.summary: 官方 LinkedIn Campaign Manager：把获客漏斗在广告、表单、跟进和 UTM 上对齐，先起草活动等人批准，并保持每个 offer 与交接干净。不自行开投。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有 Paid Media 是跨渠道预算；这里专管 LinkedIn 漏斗一致性。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不启用广告、不改预算、不对外发跟进；只返回活动草稿、UTM 与交接清单。
cases.summaryEn: Official LinkedIn Campaign Manager: owns lead-gen funnel consistency across ads, forms, follow-up, and UTMs. Drafts campaigns for approval and keeps every offer and handoff clean. Does not launch spend on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. Paid Media is cross-channel budget; this owns LinkedIn funnel consistency.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not enable ads, change budgets, or send follow-up; return campaign drafts, UTMs, and the handoff list.

cases.title: 营销日历负责人：区域/全球内容与活动对齐
cases.summary: 官方 Marketing Calendar Owner：让区域和全球的内容、上线与活动日历保持同步，从 Notion 拉取，并让 webinar 与战役不用每周人工追。不对外发公告。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有一人公司栈有 newsletter，没有区域/全球营销日历主人。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发对外公告、不改已发布档期；只返回冲突、缺口与待批日历更新。
cases.summaryEn: Official Marketing Calendar Owner: keeps regional and global content, launch, and events calendars in sync, pulls from Notion, and keeps webinars and campaigns current without a weekly chase. Does not send public announcements.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. The one-person stack has a newsletter, not a regional/global marketing-calendar owner.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send public announcements or change published dates; return conflicts, gaps, and pending calendar updates.

cases.title: 周边履约：兑换表审批后才给供应商下日单
cases.summary: 官方 Merch Fulfillment Operator：对合适的潜客做周边触达，盯兑换表，在聊天里让你批准/拒绝提交，再给供应商发每日订单，告诉他们何时何地发货。发货与对外消息必须人审。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色，审批点写进文案（chat 里批准/拒绝）。现有 29 条没有周边履约。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不批准兑换、不向供应商下单、不对外发周边；只返回待批提交与每日订单草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Merch Fulfillment Operator: runs outreach, watches the redemption form, pings you in chat to approve/reject submissions, and sends the swag vendor a daily order form so they know when and where to dispatch. Shipping and outbound messages need a human.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role with the approval gate written in (approve/reject in chat). None of the 29 cover merch fulfillment.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not approve redemptions, place vendor orders, or ship merch; return pending submissions and a daily order-form draft.

cases.title: 社区运营经理：大使申请、私信分拣与节奏培育
cases.summary: 官方 Community Operations Manager：筛大使申请、跨渠道分拣私信，并按节奏起草培育内容，让社区不再是全职追人。不自行通过申请、不私发官方承诺。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有客服退款/收件箱分拣不覆盖大使循环。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不通过/拒绝申请、不对外发私信；只返回筛选结果、分拣队列与培育草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Community Operations Manager: screens apps, triages DMs across channels, and drafts nurture on a cadence so community is not a full-time chase. Does not approve applicants or send official promises on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. Support refunds and inbox triage do not cover an ambassador loop.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not accept or reject applicants, and do not send DMs; return the screen, triage queue, and nurture drafts.

cases.title: 关键事件监测：有真实由头才建议互动
cases.summary: 官方 Compelling Events Monitor：盯管理层动态里的获奖、发布与招聘信号，交出一份可互动帖子短摘要，并按你的声音起草评论或引用转发。不自行发帖。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。现有付费监控/竞争情报不覆盖「领导层由头→待互动摘要」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发帖、不评论、不引用转发；只返回由头摘要与待审互动草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Compelling Events Monitor: watches leadership posts for awards, launches, and hiring signals, then sends a short digest of posts to engage with, plus comments or quote-reposts in your voice. Does not post on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. Paid-media monitor and competitive intel do not cover a leadership-trigger engagement digest.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not post, comment, or quote-repost; return the trigger digest and draft engagements only.

cases.title: 活动嘉宾筛选：按 ICP 打分，批量待批入邀请工具
cases.summary: 官方 Event Guest Screener：按 ICP 给活动申请打分，并把强匹配批量放进邀请工具等人批。不擅自发邀请。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色。招聘筛选吃的是职位申请；这里吃的是活动报名。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送邀请、不批量通过；只返回 ICP 打分与待批名单。
cases.summaryEn: Official Event Guest Screener: scores event applicants against your ICP and batch-approves strong fits in the invite tool. Does not send invites on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role. Hiring Screener scores job applications; this scores event applicants.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send invites or batch-approve; return ICP scores and a pending list only.

cases.title: 赋能交付：把「把录音发我」变成链接回复
cases.summary: 官方 Enablement Fulfillment Specialist：找到 Zoom 资产、做一页纸、上传到 Drive，并起草带链接的回复，避免有人再说「把录音发我」时去翻箱。不自行外发。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 CS 新角色。现有会议笔记落任务不覆盖「找 Zoom→一页纸→Drive→待发回复」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不对外发邮件、不把录音发到未经批准的对象；只返回资产链接与待发回复。
cases.summaryEn: Official Enablement Fulfillment Specialist: finds Zoom assets, builds one-pagers, uploads to Drive, and drafts the reply with links so “send me the recordings” does not mean digging. Does not send the reply on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official CS role. Meeting-notes→tasks does not cover Zoom→one-pager→Drive→draft reply.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send email or share recordings with unapproved recipients; return asset links and a draft reply.

cases.title: 工单分拣专员：盯队列，只起草回复
cases.summary: 官方 Ticket Triage Specialist：按节奏看支持队列，只起草回复，队列干净时保持安静。与政策内退款 Bot 不同：这里不碰退款，也不关单。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 CS 新角色。已有 support-in-policy-refunds 处理退款；这里是队列分拣+仅草稿。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送回复、不关单、不退款；只返回分拣与草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Ticket Triage Specialist: watches support on a cadence, drafts replies only, and stays quiet when it is clean. Distinct from in-policy refunds: no refunds, no closing tickets.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official CS role. Existing support-in-policy-refunds handles refunds; this is queue triage with draft-only replies.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send replies, close tickets, or issue refunds; return triage and drafts only.

cases.title: 演示文稿设计师：从主模板做出可编辑链接
cases.summary: 官方 Presentation Designer：用你的主模板和品牌体系做 Deck，不从空白页开始，并交出可继续改的编辑链接。不对外发送、不改品牌主文件。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 General 新角色。Deck Updater 是会中改已有页；这里是按主模板新建。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不对外发 Deck、不改品牌主文件；只返回可编辑链接。
cases.summaryEn: Official Presentation Designer: builds on-brand decks from your master template and brand system—not a blank slide—and delivers an editable link ready to refine and present. Does not send externally or change the brand master.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official General role. Deck Updater edits an existing deck mid-call; this builds a new one from the master.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send the deck externally or change the brand master; return an editable link only.

cases.title: 对内传播经理：按对象和渠道起草，只审不发
cases.summary: 官方 Internal Communications Manager：从真实上下文起草清晰、合你声音的对内文案，并匹配对象与渠道。官方写明 review-only，绝不自行发送。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 Marketing 新角色，审批边界写进角色名（review-only）。现有幕僚长是摘要，不是对内文案起草。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送任何对内或对外消息；只返回分受众、分渠道的草稿。
cases.summaryEn: Official Internal Communications Manager: drafts clear, on-voice copy from your real context, matched to each audience and channel. Officially review-only—it never sends on its own.
cases.qualityNoteEn: New official Marketing role with review-only in the copy. Chief of Staff is a digest, not internal comms drafting.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send any internal or external message; return audience- and channel-matched drafts only.

cases.title: 隔夜销售外呼管道
cases.summary: Sales Outbound Bot 隔夜研究 CRM 客户、按 ICP/意向打分、找联系人，并用销售本人语气起草邮件与 LinkedIn 内容，只留下待审收件箱。官方要求：未批准前不发送、不入组。
cases.qualityNote: 官方 canonical 流程，带 starter prompt 与清晰审批边界。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发送、不入组；停在待审列表
cases.summaryEn: Sales Outbound Bot researches CRM accounts overnight, scores them by ICP/intent, finds contacts, and drafts email and LinkedIn copy in the seller’s voice — leaving only a review inbox. Official rule: do not send or add to sequences until approved.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official canonical flow, with a starter prompt and a clear approval boundary.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not send or add to sequences; stop at the review list

cases.title: 演示环境就绪检查清单
cases.summary: Demo Bot 隔夜拉起环境，检查产品 UI/演示数据，修复坏种子与过期数据，在客户通话前交出「演示就绪」清单。
cases.qualityNote: 结果二元清晰：demo-ready，适合销售+工程协作故事。
cases.summaryEn: Demo Bot stands up the environment overnight, checks product UI/demo data, fixes bad seeds and stale data, and hands over a “demo-ready” checklist before the customer call.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Binary, clear outcome: demo-ready. A good sales + engineering collaboration story.

cases.title: CRM 管道周一记分板
cases.summary: Bot 维护 CRM 与组织架构卫生，标记停滞与承诺风险，并在周一发布记分板，让团队一开始就对齐。
cases.qualityNote: 典型周期性运营 digest 模式。
cases.summaryEn: The Bot keeps CRM and org hygiene, flags stalled deals and commitment risk, and posts a Monday scoreboard so the team starts aligned.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A typical recurring ops-digest pattern.

cases.title: 客户跟进与温度运营
cases.summary: 根据通话纪要更新 CRM 备注、起草产品更新、开支持工单、在团队现有工具里同步下一步——工作落在真实系统里，而不只在聊天中。
cases.qualityNote: 强调「结果落到人用的系统」的内部实践案例。
cases.summaryEn: Updates CRM notes from call recaps, drafts product updates, opens support tickets, and syncs next steps in the tools the team already uses — work lands in real systems, not only in chat.
cases.qualityNoteEn: An internal practice case that stresses “results land in the systems people use.”

cases.title: 人才侦察（招聘寻源）
cases.summary: 负责寻源、候选人研究、外联草稿与日程准备。示例：找 20 名符合硬性条件的候选人、排除 ATS 重复、引用证据、起草个性化外联——不主动联系。
cases.qualityNote: 官方角色，含隐私/合规提示，适合「只起草外联」。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不联系候选人
cases.summaryEn: Owns sourcing, candidate research, outreach drafts, and calendar prep. Example: find 20 candidates who meet hard criteria, drop ATS duplicates, cite evidence, and draft personalized outreach — do not contact anyone.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official role with privacy/compliance notes. Fits “draft outreach only.”
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not contact candidates

cases.title: 付费投放监控与预算建议（仅推荐）
cases.summary: 拉取各活动花费与表现，对照月度预算与目标 CAC，给出带数字的再分配建议，并起草给增长团队的 Slack 更新——不改预算、不发送。
cases.qualityNote: 清晰的分析→推荐→审批闭环。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改预算、不发送
cases.summaryEn: Pulls spend and performance by campaign, compares them to the monthly budget and target CAC, writes a numbered reallocation recommendation, and drafts a Slack update for growth — does not change budgets or send.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A clear analyze → recommend → approve loop.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change budgets or send

cases.title: 每周费用管家
cases.summary: 从费用系统+政策汇总周报，匹配财务收件箱收据，标记缺失分类与政策例外并引用出处，为每位负责人起草一封跟进——只返回摘要与草稿。
cases.qualityNote: 高重复性财务杂务，文档强调与源数据对账。
cases.summaryEn: Builds a weekly report from the expense system + policy, matches receipts in the finance inbox, flags missing categories and policy exceptions with sources, and drafts one follow-up per owner — returns only the summary and drafts.
cases.qualityNoteEn: High-repetition finance chores; the docs stress reconciling against source data.

cases.title: 产品性能调查包
cases.summary: 例如调查昨日发布后的结账延迟：查仪表盘/链路/火焰图，返回带截图与链接的短报告，区分事实与假设，不改生产、不改告警。
cases.qualityNote: 证据优先的工程调查模式。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不改生产/告警
cases.summaryEn: Example: investigate checkout latency after yesterday’s release. Check dashboards/traces/flame graphs and return a short report with screenshots and links, separating facts from guesses. Do not change production or alerts.
cases.qualityNoteEn: An evidence-first engineering investigation pattern.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not change production/alerts

cases.title: 预发环境 Bug 复现包
cases.summary: 阅读缺陷报告，在预发用全新测试账号复现，返回精确步骤、期望/实际、截图、浏览器/OS、控制台与网络笔记、最小用例。示例触发：Slack #customer-escalations +「needs repro」。
cases.qualityNote: 最佳官方事件触发工程工作流。
cases.summaryEn: Reads the bug report, reproduces it on staging with a fresh test account, and returns exact steps, expected/actual, screenshots, browser/OS, console and network notes, and a minimal case. Example trigger: Slack #customer-escalations + “needs repro.”
cases.qualityNoteEn: The best official event-triggered engineering workflow.

cases.title: 客户健康 / 流失风险观察名单
cases.summary: 按用量、支持升级、续约时点、干系人活跃度给组合账户打分；给出证据、为何重要、建议下一步——不联系客户、不改 CRM。可升为工作日 8:00 skill+routine。
cases.qualityNote: 文档旗舰「skill → routine」示例。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不联系客户、不改 CRM
cases.summaryEn: Scores a portfolio of accounts by usage, support escalations, renewal timing, and stakeholder activity; returns evidence, why it matters, and a suggested next step — does not contact customers or edit CRM. Can be promoted to a weekday 8:00 skill+routine.
cases.qualityNoteEn: The docs’ flagship “skill → routine” example.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not contact customers or edit CRM

cases.title: 幕僚长晨间摘要
cases.summary: 对照优先级文档，回顾昨日至今的 Slack/邮件/日历/会议笔记；只返回匹配项，并附来源、为何重要、建议下一步、以及你是否欠一个决策——不发送、不改会议。
cases.qualityNote: 最常被引用的「第一个 Bot」角色。
cases.summaryEn: Against a priority doc, reviews Slack/email/calendar/meeting notes since yesterday; returns only matches, with source, why it matters, a suggested next step, and whether you owe a decision — does not send or change meetings.
cases.qualityNoteEn: The most-cited “first Bot” role.

cases.title: 收件箱分拣 → ClickUp 交接
cases.summary: 定时 Inbox Triage Bot 抓取 Gmail（+日历）、标记紧急项，把结构化简报交给幕僚长，由其在 ClickUp 创建带截止日期与优先级的任务——团队看看板而不是只看聊天。
cases.qualityNote: 社区强演示：两个窄 Agent + 现有 PM 工具作系统真源。
cases.summaryEn: A scheduled Inbox Triage Bot pulls Gmail (+ calendar), flags urgent items, and hands a structured brief to the chief of staff, who creates dated, prioritized ClickUp tasks — the team looks at a board, not only chat.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A strong community demo: two narrow Agents + an existing PM tool as system of record.

cases.title: 发票 Agent + 收件箱交接管道
cases.summary: 上传参考发票 PDF；Invoice Agent 起草同类发票、带附件的 Gmail 回复草稿，并在 ClickUp「Invoices and Payments」看板跟踪状态。可与 Inbox Triage 群聊交接，让发票邮件自动路由。
cases.qualityNote: 端到端 SMB 运营闭环；生产环境发送需审批。
cases.summaryEn: Upload a reference invoice PDF. Invoice Agent drafts a matching invoice, a Gmail reply draft with attachment, and tracks status on the ClickUp “Invoices and Payments” board. Can hand off in a group chat with Inbox Triage so invoice mail routes automatically.
cases.qualityNoteEn: End-to-end SMB ops loop; sending in production still needs approval.

cases.title: 会议笔记 → 带截止日任务（Granola @ 17:00）
cases.summary: 每天 17:00 例行抓取 Granola 笔记，提取行动项，按规则路由到正确的 ClickUp 看板（如代理 vs YouTube），并填负责人、优先级与截止日期。
cases.qualityNote: 高杠杆「会议债务」杀手。
cases.summaryEn: A 17:00 daily routine pulls Granola notes, extracts action items, routes them to the right ClickUp board (e.g. agency vs YouTube) by rule, and fills owner, priority, and due date.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A high-leverage “meeting debt” killer.

cases.title: 手机拍照生成产品广告视频
cases.titleEn: Product Ad Video from Phone Photo
cases.summary: Video Agent + Higgsfield 插件 + 已保存的产品广告 skill：在 iOS 拍产品照，提示「生成产品广告」，几分钟得到成片；skill 可用 / 引用。
cases.qualityNote: 创作者侧的 teach/skill 具体模式。
cases.summaryEn: Video Agent + Higgsfield plugin + a saved product-ad skill: shoot the product on iOS, prompt “generate a product ad,” and get a finished cut in minutes. The skill can be invoked with /.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A concrete creator-side teach/skill pattern.

cases.title: 竞争情报 / 公司模拟蜂群
cases.summary: 多个角色 Bot（研究、核实、策略、工程、营销）通过群聊共享上下文；可用 Composio 接多应用。示例：并行负责人对比编码 Agent 评测，或竞品定价/功能蜂群 → 高管简报。
cases.qualityNote: 写得最好的多 Agent 架构指南，含 token 与共享电脑安全提醒。
cases.summaryEn: Several role Bots (research, verify, strategy, engineering, marketing) share context in a group chat; Composio can connect multiple apps. Example: parallel owners comparing coding-agent evals, or a competitor pricing/feature swarm → exec brief.
cases.qualityNoteEn: The best-written multi-agent architecture guide, including token and shared-computer safety notes.

cases.title: 一人公司 / Newsletter 运营栈
cases.summary: 幕僚长审计业务并命名首批 Agent（研究、销售、平台专家）；一项目一账户控制上下文/token；例行把 newsletter、目录、Shopify 等工作挪到夜间。
cases.qualityNote: 可执行的创始人运营模型：审计 → 招聘 Agent → 周报。
cases.summaryEn: Chief of staff audits the business and names the first Agents (research, sales, platform specialist); one account per project to control context/tokens; routines move newsletter, directory, and Shopify work into the night.
cases.qualityNoteEn: An executable founder ops model: audit → hire Agents → weekly report.

cases.title: 网站上线多 Bot 小组
cases.summary: 文档模式：Website Launch 群组含上线协调、内容编辑、分析审阅；协调员分派，交接在同一对话可见。社区也有 EA 用自然语言把建站交给工程 Bot。
cases.qualityNote: 清晰的「项目舱」协作 IA。
cases.summaryEn: Docs pattern: a Website Launch group with launch coordination, content editing, and analytics review; the coordinator assigns work, and handoffs stay visible in the same thread. Community examples also have an EA handing site-building to an engineering Bot in natural language.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A clear “project pod” collaboration IA.

cases.title: Slack 触发的复现 / 升级例行
cases.summary: 窄事件规则：当 #customer-escalations 出现工单链接 +「needs repro」时，Bot 打开工单、在预发复现、在对话中贴复现包——未经批准不回帖到 Slack。避免「每条新消息」监听。
cases.qualityNote: 事件触发设计金标准：窄匹配、审批、失败策略。
cases.summaryEn: A narrow event rule: when #customer-escalations has a ticket link + “needs repro,” the Bot opens the ticket, reproduces on staging, and posts the repro pack in the thread — does not reply in Slack without approval. Avoid listening to “every new message.”
cases.qualityNoteEn: Gold standard for event-trigger design: narrow match, approval, failure policy.

cases.title: Cursor Automations：工程工厂模式（相邻）
cases.summary: 同生态的 Cursor 云端 Agent：main 推送安全审查→Slack；PR agentic codeowners；PagerDuty→Datadog 调查→Slack+修复 PR；周仓 digest；晨间覆盖率 PR；Slack 缺陷分拣→Linear→尝试修复。
cases.qualityNote: 非 Grok Bot UI，但同属 Cursor 生态「常开 Agent」模式，适合 Coding/DevOps 筛选。
cases.summaryEn: Same-ecosystem Cursor cloud Agents: main-push security review→Slack; PR agentic codeowners; PagerDuty→Datadog investigation→Slack+fix PR; weekly repo digest; morning coverage PR; Slack bug triage→Linear→attempted fix.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Not the Grok Bot UI, but the same Cursor-ecosystem “always-on Agent” pattern. Useful when filtering for Coding/DevOps.

cases.title: 演示教学：把浏览器流程存成 Skill
cases.titleEn: Teach a Task: Demo a Browser Workflow into a Skill
cases.summary: 官方 Skills / Routines 文档给出的可执行模式：在一对一对话打开电脑视图，选 Teach a task，演示最多约 10 分钟的浏览器流程，Bot 生成草稿 Skill。补上决策规则、失败处理和审批边界后再用 Test run，最后才做成例行。不录音频，演示中不要暴露密钥，凭证走安全交接。
cases.qualityNote: 官方「先一次性任务 → Skill → Routine」闭环，和现有业务角色案例互补，可直接照文档操作。
cases.approvalBoundary: 写操作与外发保持审批；演示时不暴露密钥
cases.summaryEn: The executable pattern from the official Skills / Routines docs: open computer view in a 1:1, choose Teach a task, demo a browser flow of about 10 minutes max, and the Bot drafts a Skill. Add decision rules, failure handling, and approval bounds, then Test run, and only then turn it into a routine. No audio recording; do not expose secrets during the demo; hand credentials over securely.
cases.qualityNoteEn: The official “one-off task → Skill → Routine” loop. Complements the business-role cases and can be followed from the docs.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Keep writes and outbound behind approval; do not expose secrets during the demo

cases.title: 把几十条访谈视频收成一条可看的成片
cases.titleEn: Research, transcribe, and cut a science video brief
cases.summary: KanekoaTheGreat 用自然语言让 Grok Bot 找出 Dr. Roger Seheult 谈阳光、红光、红外与线粒体的全部相关视频（含 MedCram，以及与 Huberman、Eric Berg、Steven Bartlett 等的访谈）。几分钟后交出：38 条视频转写合成一份 Word、精选 13 段科学讲解并剪成 19:35 成片、以及带原片时间戳的 Markdown 摘要。无脚本、无代码。
cases.qualityNote: 社区真人工作流：非程序员用一句话把「搜片—转写—精选—剪辑—摘要」一次做完。适合作为研究/内容 Bot 的示范，外发成片前仍建议人审。
cases.approvalBoundary: 成片与对外发布前需人审；注明素材来源与时间戳，不把转写当最终引用。
cases.summaryEn: KanekoaTheGreat asked Grok Bot in natural language to find every Dr. Roger Seheult video on sunlight, red light, infrared, and mitochondria (including MedCram and talks with Huberman, Eric Berg, Steven Bartlett, and others). Minutes later it returned: a Word file of 38 video transcripts, 13 science segments cut into a 19:35 film, and a Markdown brief with source timestamps. No script, no code.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A real community workflow: a non-programmer finished “find–transcribe–select–edit–summarize” in one sentence. A good research/content Bot demo; still review before publishing the cut.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Human review before the cut goes public; cite sources and timestamps, and do not treat transcripts as final quotes.

cases.title: 数字断舍离：邮箱、网盘与订阅审计
cases.summary: 官方扩容帖里的 Digital declutterer：全天候审计邮箱、Drive 和付费订阅，整理出可取消清单（金额、最近使用）。只有你点头才丢弃或退订。
cases.qualityNote: 官方「Jobs Bots are doing today」新角色，审批边界非常清晰：只审计、列清单，退订必须人审。适合作为第一个生活向 Routine。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不丢弃文件、不退订、不删除账号；只返回审计清单。
cases.summaryEn: Digital declutterer from the official expansion post: around-the-clock audit of email, Drive, and paid subscriptions, producing a cancel list (amount, last used). It discards or unsubscribes only after you nod.
cases.qualityNoteEn: A new official “Jobs Bots are doing today” role. The approval bound is very clear: audit and list only; canceling needs a human. A good first life-admin Routine.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not discard files, unsubscribe, or delete accounts; return only the audit list.

cases.title: 会议替身：缺席时入会并带回摘要
cases.summary: 官方扩容角色 Meeting stand-in：你去不了时由 Bot 入会、向房间说明你在场、做详细笔记并发送摘要，让你事后仍跟得上。
cases.qualityNote: 和「会议笔记 → 任务」不同：这是真人缺席时的入会替身。日历/会议权限敏感，摘要外发需审批。
cases.approvalBoundary: 入会与对外发摘要前需人审；不代为做承诺或改日程。
cases.summaryEn: Official expansion role Meeting stand-in: when you cannot go, the Bot joins, tells the room you are represented, takes detailed notes, and sends a summary so you can still catch up.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Different from “meeting notes → tasks”: this is a stand-in when a person is absent. Calendar/meeting permissions are sensitive; sending the summary needs approval.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Joining and sending the summary need human review; do not make commitments or change the calendar.

cases.title: 建站 Bot：做站、买域名、部署上线
cases.summary: 官方扩容角色 Website builder：搭建站点、购买域名并部署最终版本，协助配置插件、交出可访问 URL，并加上跳转规则。与「多 Bot 上线小组」互补，这是单 Bot 端到端交付。
cases.qualityNote: 官方点名会买域名和部署，属于高后果动作。适合先在草稿环境做站，域名购买与 DNS/跳转必须审批。
cases.approvalBoundary: 不购买域名、不改 DNS、不部署到生产；先交出预览站与清单。
cases.summaryEn: Official expansion role Website builder: build the site, buy a domain, and deploy the final version, help configure plugins, hand over a reachable URL, and add redirect rules. Complements the multi-bot launch group; this is one Bot delivering end to end.
cases.qualityNoteEn: Officially named as buying domains and deploying — high-consequence actions. Build in a draft environment first; domain purchase and DNS/redirects must be approved.
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not buy a domain, change DNS, or deploy to production; hand over a preview site and a checklist first.

cases.title: 游戏美术 Bot：按方向产出管线资产
cases.summary: 官方扩容帖里的 Game artist：进入现有美术管线，按你的创作方向制作定制资产，再把游戏真正需要的东西交回来。适合先在草稿目录出图，入库与覆盖正式资源必须人审。
cases.summaryEn: Game artist from the official expansion post: visits the art pipeline, makes custom assets according to your creative direction, and comes back with what the game needs. Draft in a scratch folder first; promoting or overwriting production assets needs a human.
cases.qualityNote: 官方「Jobs Bots are doing today」里尚未入库的角色：有明确管线入口和交付物，但不写「直接覆盖生产美术」。适合当内容向 Skill 的示范。
cases.qualityNoteEn: An official “Jobs Bots are doing today” role not yet listed: a clear pipeline in and a deliverable out, without claiming it should overwrite production art. A good content-side Skill demo.
cases.approvalBoundary: 不覆盖正式美术目录、不提交到发行分支、不对外发布；只交草稿资产与清单。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not overwrite the production art tree, commit to a release branch, or publish; hand over draft assets and a list only.

cases.title: 办公室经理：工单、排班与门户代劳
cases.summary: 官方扩容角色 Office manager：接收工单、规划产能，并在 Gmail、Slack、ServiceTitan、Quo 和客户门户之间代为点选。让店主不必同时活在六个工具里。预约、改价、对外消息默认停在审批。
cases.summaryEn: Official expansion role Office manager: intakes work orders, plans capacity, and does the browser work across Gmail, Slack, ServiceTitan, Quo, and the client portal so a shop owner does not have to live in six tools. Booking, price changes, and outbound messages stop for approval by default.
cases.qualityNote: 官方点名的多门户代劳角色，和已有的收件箱分拣不同：对象是工单与排班，而不是邮件归档。高后果动作（下单、改预约）必须人审。
cases.qualityNoteEn: An official multi-portal operator role, distinct from inbox triage: it owns work orders and capacity, not mail filing. High-consequence actions (booking, changing appointments) need a human.
cases.approvalBoundary: 不确认预约、不改价、不向客户发送消息；只整理工单队列与建议排班。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not confirm bookings, change prices, or message customers; return a work-order queue and a suggested schedule only.

cases.title: 客服退款 Bot：政策内退款先拟后批
cases.summary: 官方扩容角色 Customer support：阅读支持邮件并接入支付服务商，处理政策内的常规退款。Gergely Orosz 在 2026-08-19 公开过同一形态：Grok Bot 连接支持邮箱与 Stripe API，每笔先在 Bot 界面确认再打款。
cases.summaryEn: Official expansion role Customer support: reads support mail, connects to the payments provider, and handles routine in-policy refunds. Gergely Orosz published the same shape on 2026-08-19: Grok Bot on support email plus the Stripe API, confirming each refund in the Bot UI before money moves.
cases.qualityNote: 官方角色 + 社区真人跑通：政策内退款是钱，必须先拟草稿、人点头。和已有的收件箱分拣不同，这条连到支付 API。
cases.qualityNoteEn: Official role plus a real community run: in-policy refunds are money, so draft first and wait for a nod. Distinct from inbox triage because it talks to the payments API.
cases.approvalBoundary: 不发起退款、不改支付方式、不自动回复顾客；先提交订单号、金额、政策对照与待批草稿。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not issue a refund, change the payment method, or auto-reply to the customer; first return order id, amount, policy check, and a draft for approval.

cases.title: 边推婴儿车边用语音买菜
cases.titleEn: Voice grocery shopping on a walk
cases.summary: Debbie O'Brien 在手机上用语音让 Grok Bot 往 Alcampo 购物车加东西：截图核对品牌、按照片认零食、查肉饼含肉比例，验证码自己过，付款她最终点头。之后还让 Bot 比了别家超市的同品牌价格。她把这件事从幕僚长里拆成独立的 Shopping Bot，以免上下文被购物填满。
cases.summaryEn: Debbie O'Brien used voice on her phone so Grok Bot could add to an Alcampo cart: screenshot the brands, identify snacks from a photo, check meat percentage on burgers, she cleared captchas herself, and she gave the final okay on payment. Afterwards the Bot compared named-brand prices at other delivery supermarkets. She split this off the chief of staff into a dedicated Shopping Bot so shopping would not fill the context window.
cases.qualityNote: 社区真人教程，不是官网一句话角色：移动端语音、截图核对、人过验证码、付款必须人审。适合当生活向 Routine 的示范。
cases.qualityNoteEn: A real community walkthrough, not a one-line official role: mobile voice, screenshot checks, a human on captchas, and payment only after a nod. A good life-admin Routine demo.
cases.approvalBoundary: 不付款、不保存支付方式、不改配送地址；只维护购物车并交出清单与截图。
cases.approvalBoundaryEn: Do not pay, save a payment method, or change the delivery address; keep the cart and return a list plus screenshots.
